additional_info.body:
Dear Johannes,
I am reaching out from the Expert Services Team in regards of ticket
ID0440326.
Thank you very much for raising the ticket and for reporting the timestamps of the interrupted sessions.
As per request, I am proceeding to install the EcoG Hotfix v1.4.11 on the three charger,
OwJ5rd
,
VaBjRf
and
ADk5zQ
.
In the meanwhile, could you kindly share with me the results of your pre-analysis of the logs? I would like to understand which are the symptoms of these charging interruptions, if we are talking about multiple scenarios of charging stop or only of one pattern, and if it happens with a specific vehicle brand/model.
These information are crucial to know before starting the investigation. Also, could you please confirm that the timestamps you reported are all belonging to charger
ADk5zQ?
Thank you very much in advance for your reply and for sharing your pre-analysis of the logs.
Looking forward to hearing feedback from you!
With kind regards,
